_README: Documented regression-gate floor. These are the CURRENT measured baseline numbers (see docs/technical/synthesis-eval.md) — the gate locks in today's honest quality and fails CI on a regression below it. Raise these only when a real model/prompt improvement lifts the measured floor; never lower them to make a red gate green. `min_term_coverage` is a fraction in [0,1]; `max_ungrounded_entities` is a per-recap ceiling on flagged hallucinations; `in_language_baseline` lists each label's expected in-language verdict (true entries are asserted — a regression from in-language to not fails the gate; false entries are documented known limitations of the default model and are NOT re-asserted).
